tasks.short: Produce the drawings for the project.

steps.what: Open the sketch and the sheet list.
Produce the drawings with drafting tools or by hand.
Check each drawing against the sketch.

tasks.design: The sheet list is opened from {PROJECT} before the work. The drafter produces the drawings on the drawing model in {OTHER}, or by hand when the job is drawn that way. A filled title block is not a drawing. The sketch check is the drafter's, and nothing is issued from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sheet numbers and the sketch lived in separate piles, so the drawing started from memory of the set.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheet list can be open. The drawing itself is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A line the sketch does not settle, and a view that has to be constructed.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see that a complete title block still leaves the view wrong.
tasks.altitude: The sheet list is ready. The drawings are still produced by the drafter. Nothing is issued.

reach.task: Give a sketch and expect the drawing to be produced by the drafter.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The drawing cannot.

evidence.claim: A sheet list can be opened from the project file. It cannot produce the drawing.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id and sketch id, produced by the project file. A sheet with no sketch id is not marked drawn. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which sheets are drawn by hand.
research_questions: How many sheets start from a sketch rather than a model?
Who may mark a sheet drawn?

already_counted.description: The drafter still produces the drawings.
The drafter still checks the sheet.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a sheet the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the sheet list. It disappears when the sketch is not filed and the drafter starts from a paper copy. The drawing time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read codes for their effect on the design.

steps.what: List building codes and by-laws for this building type.
Mark space and site requirements named in those documents.

loop.input: the clause list and the technical documents
loop.check: each mark cites a clause in the file
loop.stop: stop when a mark cites nothing
loop.why_not_simpler: code text is prose, and a keyword list invents a clearance

steps.what: Analyze the effect on the architectural designs.
Record the effect the drafter found.

tasks.design: Clauses for the building type are listed from {DOCS}, including by-laws and site requirements already filed. A mark must cite a clause. The drafter analyzes the effect on the architectural design. The list does not pass the design. An engineer still signs the conclusion, and a kwaliteitsborger still tests a new class 1 building.
tasks.previous_blocker: Code extracts sat in a folder, and the effect on the plan was judged from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Clauses already filed for the building type can be listed before the reading.
tasks.still_hard: A clause the list does not contain, and a site condition the text does not measure.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a cited clause that does not apply to this plan.

ambition.what: Each filed clause for the building type is marked cited or not applicable before the drafter writes the effect.

tasks.altitude: The clause list is ready. The effect on the design is still the drafter's analysis. No design is passed.

reach.task: Sign a code conclusion after the clauses have been listed.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The signature stays with the engineer.

evidence.claim: A clause list can be shown for a building type, and a mark can be held to a citation. It cannot decide the effect on the design.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a clause already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Building type and clause id, produced by the code file. A building type with no list is not checked. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the code extracts the practice already keeps. The engineer signs outside this task.
A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a clause already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.
unknowns: Which code edition this project uses.
Whether the project is a class 1 building under the national quality regime.
research_questions: Is the clause list current for this building type?
Which effects are always referred to the engineer?

already_counted.description: The drafter still analyzes the effect.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a clause the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the clause list and the citation marks. It disappears when the edition is wrong and the drafter rebuilds the reading. The effect on the design remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw scale plans from the sketches.

steps.what: Open the sketches, calculations, and specification sheets.
Draw rough and detailed scale plans for the structures.
Check the plans against the specification sheets.

tasks.design: Sketches, calculations, and specification sheets are opened from {DOCS} as one pack. The drafter draws the rough and detailed scale plans, including foundations and structures, on the drawing model in {OTHER}. The pack does not draw the plan. A missing specification sheet stops the check, not the need to draw.
tasks.previous_blocker: Calculations and sketches arrived separately, so a scale was taken from the last job.
tasks.enabler_now: The source pack can be one set before the drafter starts.
tasks.still_hard: A dimension the calculation does not give, and a foundation the sketch leaves open.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a scale that is consistent and still the wrong view.
tasks.altitude: The source pack is together. The scale plans are still drawn by the drafter. Nothing is issued.

reach.task: Provide calculations and expect the scale plan to be drawn by the drafter.
reach.learn: The pack can be assembled. The plan cannot.

evidence.claim: A source pack can collect sketches and specification sheets. It cannot draw a scale plan.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Sketch id and specification id, produced by the project file. A plan with no specification id is not marked checked. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which plans are still drawn by hand.
research_questions: Are calculations filed against the sheet?
What share of plans start without a specification sheet?

already_counted.description: The drafter still draws the plans.

incremental.description: The drafter fetches a specification sheet the pack missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling the source pack. It disappears when the sheets are not filed and the drafter hunts them. The drawing time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the structural, electrical, and mechanical sheets.
Coordinate the designs and the method of presentation.
Record how the building plans will be represented.

tasks.design: Structural, electrical, and mechanical sheets are listed from {PROJECT}. The drafter coordinates the designs and decides how to represent the building plans. The list does not resolve a clash. A discipline with no sheets is not marked coordinated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each discipline kept its own set, and clashes were found when the sheets were overlaid late.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheet index can show which discipline files exist before the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: A clash the index cannot see, and a presentation the architect has not chosen.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see two sheets that share a number and still disagree.
tasks.altitude: The sheet index is shared. Coordination and the method of presentation stay with the drafter.

reach.task: Issue a discipline set and expect the drafter to find the overlay problems.
reach.learn: The index can list the sheets. The coordination cannot.

evidence.claim: A sheet index can list discipline files. It cannot coordinate the designs.
Choosing how plans are represented is the drafter's decision. The index must not mark a set coordinated because the files exist.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Discipline id and sheet id, produced by the project index. A discipline with no sheet id is left open. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project index the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which disciplines are in this project.
Who decides the presentation method with the drafter.
research_questions: Are all disciplines in one index?
What share of clashes appear only on overlay?

already_counted.description: The drafter still records the method.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a sheet the index missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the discipline list. It disappears when a discipline is outside the index and the drafter collects the sheets. The coordination time remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The drafter still produces the drawings and still coordinates the disciplines. A code list can be open before that work, and it does not pass the design.
reach: Civil engineers sign a code conclusion, and this job learns a clause list is not that signature.
Architects set the design concept, and this job learns the drawing still has to be produced.
skills_to_grow: Read a code clause against the drawing before calling the check done.
Keep the scale plan as the drafter's drawing, not as a filled title block.
role.ambitious_version: A known building type opens with its code clauses listed, and the drawings are still produced by the drafter.
